zh.subtitle: 文档转换
zh.searchLabel: 搜索 Markdown 文件或文件夹
zh.noMatch: 未找到匹配文件或文件夹
zh.noFolders: 请打开右上角的设置，在“搜索”中添加搜索目录。
zh.moreKeywords: 换一个关键词，或添加其他搜索目录。
zh.author: 版权所有者 · © 右侧
zh.shortcutHint: 点击后按下新的组合键。
zh.updateOffline: 无法检查更新，稍后重试
zh.fewerResults: 仅显示前 80 项，请缩小搜索范围。
zh.desktopRequired: 请运行 npm start 打开桌面版。
zh.shortcutConflict: 快捷键已被占用，请换一个组合。
zh.chooseMarkdown: 请从搜索结果或文件选择器中选择 Markdown。
zh.fileMissing: 文件已移动或删除，请刷新索引。
zh.previewExpired: 预览已失效，请重新选择文件。
zh.shortcutFailed: 快捷键注册失败，请从托盘打开设置并更换快捷键。
zh.indexLimit: 索引达到容量上限，请在设置中缩小搜索范围。
zh.fileTooLarge: 文件超过 10 MB，请选择较小的 Markdown 文件。
zh.imageSupport: （支持 HTTPS 图片与本地 SVG、PNG、JPEG、GIF、WebP；远程图片需要网络）
zh.autoSearchHint: 优先发现常用文件夹，搜索 Markdown 及其文件夹。跳过系统和依赖目录。
zh.indexingHint: 正在后台发现文件，已有结果可以直接打开。
zh.indexSaveFailed: 索引未能保存，下次启动将重新扫描。
zh.watchUnavailable: 此位置的文件变化将定期检查：
zh.scopeLimited: 部分磁盘暂未发现，可手动添加搜索目录。
zh.batchScope: 仅列出搜索范围内的 Markdown，遵循排除目录设置。
zh.batchIndexing: 索引仍在更新，完成后可刷新列表。
zh.batchOutputHint: 保留子目录结构，同名 PDF 自动编号。
zh.batchDestination: 选择 PDF 输出文件夹
zh.batchBusy: 正在批量转换，请稍候或取消任务。
zh.batchLimit: 每次最多转换 2,000 个 Markdown，请选择较小的文件夹。
zh.externalStyles: 未加载外部样式表。请把所需 CSS 放入文档内的 <style> 或内联 style 中。
zh.cssResources: 样式中引用的外部或本地背景图片、字体尚未加载；这些部分可能与原文不同。
zh.dynamicContent: 脚本和嵌入式网页未运行，依赖它们的内容可能缺失。
zh.previewLinkUnavailable: 无法定位链接目标，请检查原文中的目录链接。
zh.diagramSource: 图表代码（如 Mermaid）尚未渲染，PDF 中保留了源代码。可先导出 SVG 或 PNG，再作为图片插入。
zh.inlineSvg: 直接嵌入 HTML 的 SVG 可能不完整。请保存为 SVG 文件，再使用图片引用。
zh.brokenAnchor: 部分文内链接找不到目标。请检查源文件的章节名称或 HTML 锚点。
zh.localLinks: 指向其他本地文件的链接暂不支持跳转，PDF 中保留了链接文字。
zh.mathError: 部分数学公式无法解析，PDF 中保留了错误标记，请检查公式语法。
zh.sourceMathDelimitersRepaired: 已将多行公式两端独占一行的 $ 补为 $$，仅用于本次转换；原文件未修改。
zh.sourceMathDelimitersUncertain: 这里可能是误用单个 $ 包围的多行公式，但公式内容无法解析，已保留原样。请检查分隔符及 LaTeX 语法。
zh.sourceListSpaceRepaired: 已为连续列表的横杠补上空格，仅用于本次转换；原文件未修改。
zh.sourceListSpaceUncertain: 这里可能是漏空格的列表，也可能是普通文本，已保留原样。若要列表，请在横杠后加空格。
zh.sourceIndentedList: 这些行可能因额外缩进而被解析为段落或代码，已保留原样。若要顶层列表，请去掉横杠前多余的缩进。
zh.sourceInlineList: 疑似多个列表项写在同一行，已保留原样。若要列表，请将每一项另起一行。
zh.sourceMoreIssues: 文档还有更多格式提示，此处仅显示前 100 项。
zh.updateDownloadFailed: 下载或校验失败 · 重试
zh.updateUnsupported: 请使用 Windows 安装版更新
zh.resetCategory: 恢复此分类的默认设置
zh.loginUnavailable: 开机启动需要安装 Windows 或 macOS 版本。
zh.searchWidthHint: 拖动左右或上下边缘，可围绕中心对称调整宽高。尺寸会自动记住。
zh.markdownSearchOnly: 搜索 Markdown 文件，以及包含 Markdown 的文件夹。
zh.sampleHint: 固定示例 · 不会读取你的文件
zh.destinationsource: 与 Markdown 保存在同一目录
zh.openAfterExport: 导出单个文件后打开 PDF
zh.preserveFolders: 批量导出时保留子目录
zh.batchDestinationHint: 批量导出会按文件夹名称归档。选择同目录保存时，每份 PDF 会放在对应 Markdown 旁边。
zh.collisionHint: 默认同名文件自动编号，例如：笔记 (2).pdf。手动选择已有文件时，系统会询问是否替换。
zh.copyrightHint: 左侧默认使用文档标题。两个输入框只改变 PDF 末尾的版权行，不会修改正文标题。
zh.unsavedCloseHint: 排版更改尚未保存。你可以保存后关闭，或放弃本次更改。
zh.unsavedTabHint: 离开排版前，要保存本次更改吗？放弃后将恢复已保存的排版。
zh.descriptiongeneral: 让印页适应你的日常习惯。
zh.descriptionlayout: 调整 PDF 的样式，实时查看模板。
zh.descriptionexport: 选择 PDF 的存放位置与导出方式。
zh.advancedHint: 按需调整。标题数值留空时使用主题默认样式。
zh.keepHeadings: 标题与后文保持在同页
zh.paginationHint: 超过一页高度的表格或代码块仍会分页，尽量保持完整而不裁切内容。
zh.decorationTokens: 可用 {title}、{file}、{date}、{page}、{pages} 表示文档标题、文件名、日期、当前页和总页数。
zh.label: 第 1 页，共 10 页
zh.pageNumbersOffHint: 请开启上方的“页码”开关，以显示自动页码。
zh.comparisonHint: 固定 A4 示例，仅用于比较规则，不会改变你的排版设置。
zh.headingSpacingHint: 间距作用于当前级别标题；页边界可能省略空白。右侧示例包含 H1–H6，可直接查看排版效果。
zh.chapterRuleUnavailable: 当前选择的是“不强制分页”，无法开启规则。请先在左侧“章节另起一页”中选择一级或二级标题分页。
zh.developmentUpdateHint: 开发版从本地源码运行，不下载或安装正式版更新。

en.subtitle: Document Converter
en.noFolders: Open Settings above, then add a folder under Search.
en.moreKeywords: Try another filename or add a search folder.
en.author: Copyright holder · after ©
en.shortcutHint: Click, then press a new key combination.
en.updateOffline: Unable to check. Try again later.
en.desktopRequired: Run npm start to open the desktop app.
en.chooseMarkdown: Select a Markdown file from search or the file picker.
en.renderBusy: A preview is being prepared. Please wait.
en.fileMissing: The file has moved or was deleted. Refresh the index.
en.previewExpired: Preview expired. Select the file again.
en.shortcutFailed: Shortcut unavailable. Open settings from the tray to change it.
en.indexLimit: Index capacity reached. Narrow the search scope in Settings.
en.fileTooLarge: File exceeds 10 MB. Choose a smaller Markdown file.
en.imageSupport: (HTTPS images and local SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP supported; remote images need a connection)
en.autoSearchHint: Common folders first. Search Markdown and its folders. System and dependency folders are skipped.
en.indexingHint: Discovering files in the background. Existing results are ready to open.
en.indexSaveFailed: Unable to save the index. It will be rebuilt next time.
en.indexFailed: Unable to update the search index:
en.watchUnavailable: Changes at this location will be checked periodically:
en.scopeLimited: Some drives are unavailable. You can add folders manually.
en.batchScope: Markdown in your search scope. Folder exclusions apply.
en.batchIndexing: Indexing continues. Refresh this list when it finishes.
en.batchOutputHint: Keep subfolders. Number existing PDF names automatically.
en.batchBusy: A batch is running. Wait or cancel it first.
en.batchLimit: A batch supports up to 2,000 Markdown files. Choose a smaller folder.
en.externalStyles: External stylesheets were not loaded. Include the CSS in a document <style> block or inline style.
en.cssResources: Background images or fonts referenced by CSS were not loaded from external or local URLs. These parts may differ from the source.
en.dynamicContent: Scripts and embedded web pages did not run. Content that depends on them may be missing.
en.previewLinkUnavailable: Link destination unavailable. Check the source document link.
en.diagramSource: Diagram code (such as Mermaid) was kept as source text. Export it as SVG or PNG and insert it as an image to include the diagram.
en.inlineSvg: SVG embedded directly in HTML may be incomplete. Save it as an SVG file and reference it as an image.
en.brokenAnchor: Some internal links have no matching destination. Check heading names or HTML anchors in the source.
en.localLinks: Links to other local files cannot be followed yet. Their text is retained in the PDF.
en.mathError: Some math could not be parsed. Error markers remain in the PDF; check the formula syntax.
en.sourceMathDelimitersRepaired: Changed standalone $ delimiters around a multiline formula to $$ for this conversion only. The source file was not changed.
en.sourceMathDelimitersUncertain: This may be a multiline formula enclosed in single $ delimiters, but its contents could not be parsed. It was kept unchanged. Check the delimiters and LaTeX syntax.
en.sourceListSpaceRepaired: Added spaces after hyphens in a consecutive list for this conversion only. The source file was not changed.
en.sourceListSpaceUncertain: This may be a list missing spaces or ordinary text. It was kept unchanged. For a list, add a space after each hyphen.
en.sourceIndentedList: Extra indentation may cause these lines to render as prose or code. They were kept unchanged. Remove excess indentation for a top-level list.
en.sourceInlineList: Several possible list items share one line. They were kept unchanged. Put each item on its own line to make a list.
en.sourceMoreIssues: More formatting notices exist; only the first 100 are shown here.
en.updateUnsupported: Updates require the Windows installed app
en.loginUnavailable: Launch at login requires an installed Windows or macOS app.
en.searchWidthHint: Drag the sides or top and bottom to resize symmetrically around the center. Your size is remembered.
en.markdownSearchOnly: Search Markdown files and folders containing Markdown.
en.sampleHint: Fixed sample · your files stay untouched
en.destinationsource: Same folder as the Markdown file
en.askExportLocation: Ask where to save each time
en.openAfterExport: Open PDF after a single export
en.batchDestinationHint: Batch exports are grouped by folder name. Same-folder exports place each PDF beside its Markdown file.
en.collisionHint: Existing names get a number, such as Notes (2).pdf. When choosing an existing file manually, the system asks before replacing it.
en.copyrightHint: The left side defaults to the document title. Both fields affect only the copyright line at the end of the PDF.
en.unsavedCloseHint: Your layout changes have not been saved. Save them before closing, or discard this draft.
en.unsavedTabHint: Save your changes before leaving Layout? Discarding restores the saved layout.
en.descriptiongeneral: Make Inkleaf fit your everyday workflow.
en.descriptionsearch: Choose where to find your Markdown.
en.descriptionlayout: Shape your PDF with a live sample.
en.descriptionexport: Choose where and how your PDFs are saved.
en.advancedHint: Optional controls. Leave heading fields blank to use the theme.
en.paginationHint: Tables and code blocks taller than a page still split. These controls guide pagination without clipping content.
en.decorationTokens: Use {title}, {file}, {date}, {page} or {pages} for document title, filename, date, current page or total pages.
en.label: Page 1 of 10
en.pageNumbersOffHint: Turn on Page numbers above to display automatic page numbering.
en.comparisonHint: Controlled A4 example. These comparison settings do not change your layout.
en.headingSpacingHint: Spacing applies to this heading level; page boundaries may discard blank space. The sample includes H1–H6.
en.chapterRuleUnavailable: No forced break is selected, so this rule cannot be enabled. First choose H1 or H2 under Start a new page on the left.
en.developmentLoginHint: The development app does not launch at login.
en.developmentUpdateHint: This development app runs from local source. Release downloads and installation are disabled.
